name: Lab artifacts: fonts and video are served with their types
description: LAB-ARTIFACTS-4 (src/lab/artifacts.rs: type_of). A design's TrueType and OpenType fonts, WOFF2, WebM and an MP4 upload, AVIF, JSON and scripts are each served with its own media type, every one with obid's artifact CSP and nosniff; a .jsx stays application/octet-stream, as the format needs none. (Fetching a design's Google fonts into it comes with the renderer, the artifactview PR, where the board is drawn offline.)
